summary: In the disconnected cluster, log in with oc login --token=<token> --server=<api_url> (or export KUBECONFIG and oc login) and make sure the cluster trusts the private registry holding the mirrored images.
questions: How do I log in to a disconnected OpenShift cluster with a token?
Cluster must trust the private registry for the portal install
Use a kubeconfig with oc login
